writing.explanation: Interval DP belongs to 2D & Advanced Dynamic Programming. Its invariant is the part that stays true after every step; tracing that invariant is more reliable than memorising lines. Typical uses include bursting, merging, polygon triangulation.
writing.feedback: The invariant explains both correctness and which state may change.
